disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与编译产物中是否读取或引用本地凭据文件（凭据配置、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭证等敏感路径），未发现任何敏感路径访问。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and compiled artifacts for reading or referencing local credential files (credential configs, SSH private keys, cloud provider credentials, etc., sensitive paths), no sensitive path access found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否批量搜集 API Key、Token 或云凭据的代码与命令路径，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for code and command paths that batch-collect API keys, tokens, or cloud credentials; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了钱包、助记词、私钥等资产读取面，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for asset reading surfaces such as wallets, mnemonics, private keys; none found.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何对本地凭据文件或敏感目录的读取代码路径（源码、编译产物与安装脚本均无命中），凭据读取面不成立。
evidence.en: No code paths reading local credential files or sensitive directories found (no hits in source code, compiled artifacts, or install scripts); credential reading surface is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了三个注册给模型的工具说明文本（列出工作流、运行工作流、管理工作流），均为功能描述，未发现诱导、伪装系统消息或要求忽略规则的措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the three tool description texts registered to the model (list workflows, run workflow, manage workflows); all are functional descriptions, no wording found that induces, disguises system messages, or asks to ignore rules.

checked_items.zh: 检查了注入模型上下文的系统提示片段（说明何时使用工作流工具、子任务仍受权限管控），内容为正常使用指引，未发现指令覆盖或审批绕过措辞。
checked_items.en: Checked the system prompt fragments injected into model context (explaining when to use workflow tools, that subtasks are still subject to permission control); content is normal usage guidance, no wording found that overrides instructions or bypasses approval.

checked_items.zh: 检查了生成工作流时发给模型的作者提示模板、README 与全部文档，未发现命令注入、安装诱导或伪造消息文本。
checked_items.en: Checked the author prompt template sent to the model when generating workflows, the README, and all documentation; no command injection, installation inducement, or forged message text found.

checked_items.zh: 机制观察：斜杠命令 create 或未知工作流名会给当轮模型一次性内联工作流运行授权（用于同一轮内先侦察再生成启动、避免二次询问）；该授权按会话记录且只消费一次，内联脚本仍走静态策略与沙箱，子任务仍受 DSH 工具与审批约束，未发现可被跨轮复用或绕过授权的路径。
checked_items.en: Mechanism observation: The slash command `create` or an unknown workflow name grants a one-time inline workflow execution authorization to the current round model (used for reconnaissance then generation and launch within the same round, avoiding a second prompt); this authorization is recorded per session and consumed only once; inline scripts still go through static policy and sandbox; subtasks are still subject to DSH tool and approval constraints; no path found that can be reused across rounds or bypasses authorization.

evidence.zh: 工具说明与系统提示片段逐条做了语义审查，未检出系统指令、凭据读取诱导或越权指令；注入模型上下文的提示片段位于主入口文件的系统提示注入点，内容仅说明工具使用时机。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and system prompt fragments were reviewed semantically one by one; no system instructions, credential reading inducement, or privilege escalation instructions detected; the prompt fragments injected into model context are located at the system prompt injection point in the main entry file, and the content only describes when to use the tools.

evidence.zh: 全部模型可见文本与文档中未发现诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；一次性内联授权机制有边界约束（单轮、单次、仍走沙箱与审批），不构成安装诱导面。
evidence.en: No wording found in all model-visible text and documentation that induces installation of plugins, changes configuration, or relaxes permissions; the one-time inline authorization mechanism has boundary constraints (single round, single use, still goes through sandbox and approval), and does not constitute an installation inducement surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部子进程调用点：只用于运行 git 命令（查看工作区状态、生成差异、解析提交号），命令名与参数均为固定数组、不经 shell，未发现命令拼接注入面；审查目标路径在调用前做了目录约束校验。
checked_items.en: Checked all subprocess invocation points: only used to run git commands (view workspace status, generate diffs, parse commit hashes); command name and arguments are fixed arrays, not through shell; no command injection surface found; the target path is validated against directory constraints before invocation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态执行面：受限工作流脚本先过静态策略（拒绝导入、进程、文件、shell、网络、定时器、动态代码等），再在独立的 QuickJS 沙箱中运行，设有内存、栈、CPU 与墙钟上限及 JSON 边界；静态策略里拒绝子进程的清单本身命中了扫描规则，但它是安全拦截机制而非风险。
checked_items.en: Checked the dynamic execution surface: restricted workflow scripts first pass through a static policy (rejects imports, processes, files, shell, network, timers, dynamic code, etc.), then run in an independent QuickJS sandbox with limits on memory, stack, CPU, wall clock, and JSON boundary; the list of rejected subprocesses in the static policy itself triggered the scan rules, but it is a security interception mechanism, not a risk.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装期行为：包描述文件没有安装前/安装后/准备钩子（仅打包前构建），未发现下载即执行或远程载荷执行路径；工作区构建放行清单仅含 esbuild。
checked_items.en: Checked installation-time behavior: the package description file has no pre-install/post-install/prepare hooks (only pre-pack build); no download-and-execute or remote payload execution path found; the workspace build whitelist only includes esbuild.

checked_items.zh: 检查了构建脚本与测试文件中的子进程调用：构建脚本仅校验开发环境 git 提交号，测试文件仅用于测试，均不随插件发布。
checked_items.en: Checked subprocess invocations in build scripts and test files: build scripts only check the git commit hash in the development environment; test files are only for testing; neither is shipped with the plugin.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁全文仅向配置合成树插入插件自身条目，未发现可被加载器求值的脚本标记，补丁即执行面不成立。
evidence.en: The entire patch config only inserts the plugin's own entry into the configuration composition tree; no script markers that can be evaluated by the loader found; the patch-as-execution surface is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包工具（把模型代码塞进宿主虚拟机执行）的调用；用户工作流脚本被限制在独立 QuickJS 沙箱内，与宿主隔离。
evidence.en: No invocation of dynamic package tools (injecting model code into the host VM for execution) found; user workflow scripts are confined to an independent QuickJS sandbox, isolated from the host.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子与树内执行载体（无 hook 管理器、无 CI 工作流、无 devcontainer、无子模块配置）；README 安装示例使用分支名（未锁定提交）属文档习惯建议，插件本身无浮动 git 依赖。
evidence.en: No install hooks or in-tree execution vectors (no hook manager, no CI workflow, no devcontainer, no submodule configuration); the README installation example uses a branch name (commit not locked) which is a documentation habit suggestion; the plugin itself has no floating git dependencies.

evidence.zh: 包声明仅含挂载补丁，未声明浏览器端模块，自动加载的客户端脚本面不适用。
evidence.en: The package declaration only contains the patch config; no browser-side module declared; the auto-loaded client script surface is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部网络调用（HTTP 请求、WebSocket、DNS、socket 等），未发现任何外联代码，插件无网络实现。
checked_items.en: Checked all network calls (HTTP requests, WebSocket, DNS, socket, etc.); no outbound connection code found; the plugin has no network implementation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否将读取内容编码后外发、是否设置代理或改写模型服务端点，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked whether read content is encoded and exfiltrated, whether a proxy is set, or whether model service endpoints are rewritten; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了唯一的外部程序调用（git）仅在本机执行，不构成网络外联；运行时依赖的 QuickJS 沙箱为本地 WebAssembly，无网络面。
checked_items.en: Checked the only external program call (git) executes locally only, does not constitute network outbound; the runtime dependency QuickJS sandbox is local WebAssembly with no network surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何外联通道（无 HTTP/WebSocket/DNS 调用、无 curl/wget 命令行外发），即便存在凭据读取也不存在外发载体；外联面不成立。
evidence.en: No outbound channels found (no HTTP/WebSocket/DNS calls, no curl/wget command-line exfiltration); even if credential reading existed, there is no exfiltration vector; the outbound surface is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时依赖：仅一个第三方依赖（QuickJS 沙箱运行时），版本精确锁定，无浮动版本；宿主相关包全部为对等依赖，由 DSH 宿主提供。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime dependencies: only one third-party dependency (QuickJS sandbox runtime), version pinned exactly, no floating versions; all host-related packages are peer dependencies provided by the DSH host.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装期行为：无安装钩子、无远程脚本拉取、无包名仿冒或抢注信号。
checked_items.en: Checked installation-time behavior: no install hooks, no remote script fetching, no signs of name spoofing or squatting.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁：只插入插件自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: only inserts the plugin's own entry, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, permissions; does not override injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了文档安装命令：README 示例使用分支名安装（未锁定提交），属文档层习惯建议，插件本身无浮动 git 依赖；已核对该面，未作为漏洞收录。
checked_items.en: Checked the documentation installation command: the README example uses a branch name for installation (commit not locked), which is a documentation-level habit suggestion; the plugin itself has no floating git dependencies; this surface has been reviewed and is not recorded as a vulnerability.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比对升级自动激活与能力升级信号。
checked_items.en: First audit, no previous version baseline; cannot compare auto-activation on upgrade and capability upgrade signals.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也不含禁用或环境变量降权写法，安全配置覆盖面不成立。
evidence.en: The patch config does not cover security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, permissions, nor does it contain disabling or environment variable privilege downgrade patterns; the security configuration coverage surface is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批或工具执行事件的高优先级监听或截断调用；插件使用宿主审批服务的标准请求接口，审批链完整。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners or intercepting calls for approval or tool execution events found; the plugin uses the standard request interface of the host approval service, the approval chain is intact.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法比对清单声明的突变与升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First audit, no previous version baseline; cannot compare manifest declaration mutations and auto-activation on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not override injection or interception configurations; there is no tampering surface that adds necessary services to security plugins causing them to wait indefinitely.

checked_items.zh: 检查了是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口，未发现，本机无认证调用面不适用。
checked_items.en: Checked whether a web service is started or a port is listened on; none found; the local authenticated call surface is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行期权限边界：子任务只读模式使用父 Agent 可见工具与只读白名单的交集，写能力任务受 DSH 现有审批与沙箱约束；可信本地脚本以宿主权限执行，但每次运行前需显式确认并明示警告。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime permission boundaries: subtask read-only mode uses the intersection of parent Agent visible tools and read-only whitelist; write-capability tasks are subject to existing DSH approval and sandbox constraints; trusted local scripts execute with host permissions, but require explicit confirmation and a clear warning before each run.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（无动态观测产物），运行期行为结论基于静态与语义分析。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static and semantic analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listen on any port; the local authenticated RPC surface is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件声明为 bundle 形态，挂载补丁仅插入插件自身条目，身份与名称无仿冒信号。
summary.en: The plugin is declared as a bundle form; the patch config only inserts the plugin's own entry; no identity or name spoofing signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描命中 10 处子进程相关代码，逐处核验均为固定参数的 git 命令、安全策略清单或测试/构建脚本，无命令注入与远程执行面。
summary.en: Static scan hit 10 pieces of subprocess-related code; each piece was verified to be either fixed-argument git commands, security policy lists, or test/build scripts; no command injection or remote execution surface.

summary.zh: 行为面核查未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior surface check found no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reading, or outbound domains.

summary.zh: 工具描述与系统提示片段语义审查通过，无提示词注入措辞；能力声明与代码实测一致。
summary.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions and system prompt fragments passed; no prompt injection wording; capability declarations are consistent with code verification.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase.

limits.zh:
L4 动态沙箱未启用（无动态观测产物），运行期行为结论基于静态与语义分析。

dsh.bundle 清单未声明能力字段，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断：无网络、无 shell 解释器、可写文件、面向模型（注册工具/注入提示/派生子 Agent）。

static-scan 10 条命中逐条裁决，全部为 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）子进程相关：src/engine.ts:5 与 src/index.ts:1（git 命令固定参数数组、不经 shell）、src/source-policy.ts:18（拒绝子进程的静态策略清单本身）、scripts/check-compatibility.mjs:1（构建期校验 git 提交号）、lib/engine.js:5、lib/index.js:1、lib/source-policy.js:15（编译产物同源）、tests/engine.spec.ts:396、tests/plugin.spec.ts:1、tests/source-policy.spec.ts:10（测试代码，不随发布）。均确认为良性用途，未落入发现。

包描述文件仓库字段指向 dsh-external/dsh_workflow，任务卡仓库为 omdsh-dev/dsh_workflow，两者不一致；审计以任务卡为准，不影响本快照代码结论。
limits.en:
L4 Dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic observation artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based on static and semantic analysis.

dsh.bundle manifest does not declare a capability field; declared_capabilities inferred from code verification: no network, no shell interpreter, writable files, model-oriented (register tools/inject prompts/spawn sub-agents).

static-scan 10 hits were adjudicated one by one, all related to DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) subprocess: src/engine.ts:5 and src/index.ts:1 (git commands with fixed argument arrays, not through shell); src/source-policy.ts:18 (the static policy list that rejects subprocesses itself); scripts/check-compatibility.mjs:1 (checks git commit hash during build); lib/engine.js:5, lib/index.js:1, lib/source-policy.js:15 (compiled artifacts, same origin); tests/engine.spec.ts:396, tests/plugin.spec.ts:1, tests/source-policy.spec.ts:10 (test code, not shipped). All confirmed as benign usage, not classified as findings.

Package description file repository field points to dsh-external/dsh_workflow, task card repository is omdsh-dev/dsh_workflow, the two are inconsistent; audit uses the task card as the reference, does not affect the code conclusion of this snapshot.
